subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: What shared inbound attachment metadata shape should agents receive for Slack files and comparable Discord, Telegram, and future channel attachments?
rationale: The remaining work changes the channel-to-agent context contract and privacy boundary, and a Slack-only field would likely drift from other channel plugins.

options.title: Design Shared Metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

options.title: Use Slack-Only Stopgap
options.body: Expose only Slack file metadata now, accepting later migration risk when other channels need the same shape.

options.title: Keep Current Workflow
options.body: Treat fileId placeholders plus download-file as the supported workflow and close the metadata request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Design Shared Metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already connected to the issue discussion and recent Slack media behavior, making them the best available routing owner for the product/API decision.
